facts.fact: Law 21/2011 of 14 February 2012 (Article 90) provides that each learner receives, from entry into the first pre-primary section until entry into working life, a unique identification number codified and assigned by the Education Ministry's central file; Article 94 has the schools and universities orientation secretariat draw up the nominative list of new baccalaureate holders from that central identification file; the law gives no evidence that the number is in use.
facts.system: fichier central du Ministère en charge de l'Education Nationale

systems.system: fichier central du Ministère en charge de l'Education Nationale

note: Statute only: provision for a unique learner number and one cross-service use of the central file; no exchange between systems or standard described.
